description: Comparators read cauldrons (empty 0, water and powder snow by level, lava 3) and furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers by their contents (a wooden shovel stacks to 1); a sticky piston moves a full water cauldron in front of a comparator and back, another moves a stone between a comparator and a furnace; a piston cannot push a furnace; a cauldron does not conduct a repeater's power.
